item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the 2% skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"brief_complete":false,"completion_reason":"Material outcome-scope decisions remain for Research deliverables, workflow entry points, and model customization.","questions":[{"decision_key":"research_deliverable_scope","label":"Research outcome","context":"Work will add a Research conversation mode, but its required finished product is not yet defined.","evidence":"`apps/web/app/page.jsx` does not yet have the planned Work surface, while `services/nexus-node/src/run-coordinator.mjs` already records results and artifacts; the plan must decide which of those a Research conversation must deliver.","impact":"Research can end as a readable answer or as reusable evidence for later work.","question":"What should every Research conversation produce?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Report with evidence package","consequence":"The operator receives a source-linked answer plus saved citations and artifacts, requiring stronger validation but supporting durable reuse."},{"number":2,"text":"Source-linked report only","consequence":"Research stays simple and readable, but later workflows may need to collect the underlying evidence again."},{"number":3,"text":"Evidence collection only","consequence":"Research produces reusable sources and artifacts, but the operator must request or create the final synthesis separately."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"recommendation_reason":"This matches the recorded emphasis on canonical artifacts and validated outputs while still giving the operator an immediately useful result.","priority":88},{"decision_key":"production_workflow_trigger_scope","label":"Workflow triggers","context":"Workflows will own schedules and batches, but the complete set of production entry points remains undecided.","evidence":"`packages/central-client/index.mjs` is the existing command boundary for local clients, and the planned Workflows tab explicitly owns schedules; neither fact decides whether webhooks or watched external events belong in the first production release.","impact":"Every extra trigger expands the security and recovery promises required at launch.","question":"What may start a production workflow?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Operator, schedule, or local API","consequence":"A person, a saved schedule, or the authenticated local machine-to-machine interface may start work, while internet callbacks wait for later adapters."},{"number":2,"text":"Also accept webhooks","consequence":"Approved external services may start workflows through authenticated internet callbacks, increasing launch integration and security work."},{"number":3,"text":"Accept any configured event source","consequence":"Files, queues, webhooks, and plugins may start workflows, maximizing automation but greatly widening failure and support scope."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"recommendation_reason":"It covers the already-recorded operator, schedule, and local-client needs without adding an unproven internet-facing trigger surface.","priority":84},{"decision_key":"model_customization_product_scope","label":"Model customization","context":"Models is defined around provider, model, and runtime inventory and lifecycle, but training ownership is not an explicit goal or non-goal.","evidence":"`packages/contracts/index.mjs` defines provider protocol presets and `kits/providers-kit/index.mjs` owns provider profiles and health; the verified architecture names no dataset, training, or fine-tuning subsystem.","impact":"Built-in training would turn a runtime manager into a data and compute platform.","question":"Should NexusCentral train or fine-tune models?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Operate existing models only","consequence":"Models manages discovery, verification, loading, health, and cleanup while training remains explicitly outside NexusCentral."},{"number":2,"text":"Track external training jobs","consequence":"NexusCentral submits to and monitors separate training services without owning datasets or training compute, adding integration complexity but preserving boundaries."},{"number":3,"text":"Provide built-in training","consequence":"NexusCentral owns datasets, checkpoints, training resources, and recovery, delivering one platform at substantially greater product and operational cost."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"recommendation_reason":"This keeps the six-tab product aligned with its recorded provider and runtime mission and avoids introducing an unsupported product category.","priority":80}]}
